title: Accession create-uuid-replacement rewrites GraphQL create into update and fails DynamoDB conditional
description:
## Expected
For research-proposal references, accession mode create-uuid-replacement creates a new Biblicus-keyed Reference lineage with storagePath/sha256/mediaType, attaches role=source, and leaves the proposal lineage superseded.

## Observed
augment_reference_accession_changes_for_replacement converted the replacement Reference create into an update against the old proposal row. AppSync then issued UpdateItem for the new id (which does not exist) → DynamoDB conditional request failed. Local write + S3 sync could succeed while GraphQL stayed empty (storagePath/sha256 null).

## Fix landed on epic/e2e-ingestion
Keep create as create; append supersede of the proposal lineage. Unit test: test_accession_replacement_keeps_create_and_supersedes_proposal.

## Evidence
.papyrus-runs/c46828-e2e/accession-retry.json (pre-fix); accession-graphql-retry.json + accession-verify-final.json (post-fix).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fix implemented on epic/e2e-ingestion in src/papyrus_content/accession.py (augment keeps create; supersedes proposal). Covered by test_accession_replacement_keeps_create_and_supersedes_proposal. Awaiting review/merge.
